Product Features

  • This black three-door wardrobe measures 160 cm in length, 35 cm in depth and 60 cm in height; its sleek and simple design makes it suitable for different living spaces.
  • Cabinet door with high-light panel design, texture refined and high-quality, the surface is smooth and dense, the daily stains are clean, the cleaning is very convenient.
  • Cabinet door with high-light panel design, texture refined and high-quality, the surface is smooth and dense, the daily stains are clean, the cleaning is very convenient.
  • The entire cabinet uses a triple closed structure, which perfectly hides the internal storage items and maintains the overall interior cleanliness and high visual impact.
  • Each storage space in the cabinet is equipped with a movement palette, which can freely adjust the height, and the room layout is flexible.
  • The single cabinet door in the room can be divided into two independent storage areas by a partition, the classification and reception is neat.
  • Combined with the full space on the lower level of the cabinet, the entire cabinet can vertically form a three-layer high-capacity storage partition and have excellent storage capacity.
  • The cabinet structure is solid and stable, the total capacity of up to 40kg, you can place all kinds of soft decorative pendulums calmly.
  • The external appearance of the minimalist atmosphere takes into account both the practical reception and the decoration of the room, is a versatile storage cabinet for the living room and dining room.
